quote: Finding a reliable caretaker for my 82-year-old bedridden father was stressful until we contacted Kyno Health. The attendant is exceptionally gentle with sponge baths and turning, and having a doctor on-call in Gurgaon gives us tremendous peace of mind.
author: Rajiv Malhotra

quote: After my mother's knee replacement surgery at Medanta, Kyno Health provided a 24-hour live-in caretaker and physiotherapist at our home. Her recovery was swift and completely complication-free.
author: Meenakshi K.

quote: Kyno Health is leagues ahead of traditional maid agencies. The caretaker is police-verified, follows strict hygiene protocols, and logs vitals twice daily. Outstanding service for elderly care.
author: Amitava Sengupta

quote: When my grandmother felt dizzy at night, Kyno Health's doctor arrived at our Sector 46 residence in under 25 minutes with an ECG machine. It was truly life-saving emergency care at home.
author: Sunita Deshmukh

quote: The 12-hour day caretaker for my post-stroke uncle is punctual, compassionate, and well-trained in mobility assistance. The care coordinator calls weekly to ensure everything is smooth.
author: Vikram Bansal

quote: Transparent pricing, no upfront agency commission, and quick replacement when our caretaker took personal leave. Highly recommend Kyno Health to anyone caring for aging parents in Delhi NCR.
author: Ananya Roy
